right_elbow.correction: Elbow angle too extreme at release. Keep the throwing elbow at ~90° through the acceleration phase. Drill: slow-motion arm circles focusing on 90° bend.

right_shoulder.correction: Shoulder deceleration is too abrupt. Follow through fully — let the arm sweep across your body to distribute the load. Drill: towel drill for a longer, relaxed follow-through.

left_elbow.correction: Joint is moving beyond its safe range. Reduce effort to 60–70% and rebuild mechanics with slower, deliberate repetitions.

right_wrist.correction: Wrist snap is too forceful. Reduce wrist snap and let the forearm pronation carry the velocity instead.

left_shoulder.correction: Glove arm is pulling off too quickly — disrupts balance. Decelerate the glove arm by pulling it into your chest at release.

spine1.correction: Lower back is overextending (excessive arch). Engage your core before the stride to stabilize the lumbar curve. Drill: anti-extension planks.

left_knee.correction: Lead knee overload AND fast flexion. Strengthen quads and glutes (step-ups, wall sits) and practice landing mechanics off a box.

right_knee.correction: Knee collapse AND fast movement. Single-leg squat drill at slow tempo to rebuild knee tracking before high-effort pitching.

left_wrist.correction: Joint is accelerating too quickly. Focus on smooth, sequential body rotation rather than forcing velocity from this segment.

right_collar.correction: Throwing collar snapping rapidly — AC joint stress. Slower arm action drill at 50% effort; focus on smooth clavicular rhythm.

left_hip.correction: Lead hip is both over-angled and moving fast. Work on hip stability: single-leg RDLs and lateral band walks to build glute control.

left_collar.correction: Collar bone moving too fast — scapular instability. Strengthen serratus anterior and lower trap (band pull-aparts, scap push-ups).

session_summary.advice: Focus your next bullpen on: right_elbow, right_shoulder, left_elbow. See per-joint corrections for specific drills.
